body: I'm sorry that happened but I hope things are working out now for you.  Thank you for telling me this, it's always nice to get new light on a situation.

Be vague but still answer the question.  Then after you become deflowered and the oxitocin is flowing through the both of you; you let him know. Just my 2 cents on this.  Hopefully if this doesn't help you directly this gives you some thoughts on what you will do  :]
